2027-03-07.title: K'piphtho Sunday · The Healing of the Bent Woman
readings: I give you thanks, O Lord and King
The Lord has opened my ear
2027-03-07.verse: Woman, you are set free from your ailment.

2027-03-14.title: Samio Sunday · The Healing of the Blind
readings: Solomon asks for an understanding mind
The Lord made the earth by his power
2027-03-14.verse: One thing I do know, that though I was blind, now I see.

2027-03-21.title: Hosanna Sunday · The Lord's Entry into Jerusalem
readings: If these were silent, the stones would shout
The scepter shall not depart from Judah
The ark is brought to Jerusalem
Your king comes, humble, riding on a donkey
A great multitude with palm branches
Hosanna! Blessed is the one who comes
2027-03-21.verse: Hosanna! Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord—the King of Israel!

2027-03-25.title: Pesaha · The Lord's Supper
readings: Let anyone who is thirsty come to me
Do not walk with those who lie in wait for blood
The Lord will reign on Mount Zion
The marriage supper of the Lamb
Do this in remembrance of me
2027-03-25.verse: Then he took a loaf of bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body, which is given for you. Do this in remembrance of me.”

2027-03-26.title: Good Friday · The Passion and Death of our Lord
readings: Readings of the Hours of Good Friday
Not listed in the Sacred Lectionary; follow the Hasho (Holy Week) book
The Gospels of the Passion read through the day
2027-03-26.verse: When Jesus had received the wine, he said, “It is finished.” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

2027-03-27.title: Holy Saturday · The Lord Rests in the Tomb
readings: Hush! We must not mention the name of the Lord
Buried with him by baptism into death
The tomb is sealed and guarded
2027-03-27.verse: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure by sealing the stone.

2027-03-28.title: Qyomtho · The Resurrection of our Lord
readings: He is not here; he has been raised
Daniel brought up from the lions' den
Peace, peace, to the far and the near
God raised this Jesus; we are witnesses
Christ died, was buried, and was raised
2027-03-28.verse: He is not here; for he has been raised, as he said.

2027-03-01.title: Monday of the fourth week of the Great Fast
readings: Abraham prays, and God heals Abimelech's house
May the Lord of peace give you peace at all times
Jesus walks on the sea; Peter cries, “Lord, save me!”
2027-03-01.verse: Take heart, it is I; do not be afraid.

2027-03-02.title: Tuesday of the fourth week of the Great Fast
readings: The birth of Isaac: God has brought laughter
Clothed with Christ, heirs according to the promise
Woe to the cities that did not repent
2027-03-02.verse: God has brought laughter for me; everyone who hears will laugh with me.

2027-03-03.title: Mid-Fast · Wednesday of the fourth week of the Great Fast · The Exaltation of the Cross in the middle of the Fast
readings: The Son of Man will be betrayed, killed, and raised
The bronze serpent lifted on a pole
Samuel prays at Mizpah; the people fast
O taste and see that the Lord is good
They shall look on the one whom they have pierced
No burden beyond what is necessary
The rock was Christ; God is faithful
As Moses lifted up the serpent, so must the Son of Man be lifted up
2027-03-03.verse: And just as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so must the Son of Man be lifted up, that whoever believes in him may have eternal life.

2027-03-04.title: Thursday of the fourth week of the Great Fast
readings: Hagar and Ishmael are sent away; God promises to make a nation of the boy
Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up
Love your enemies; be perfect as your heavenly Father is perfect
2027-03-04.verse: But I say to you, Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,

2027-03-05.title: Friday of the fourth week of the Great Fast · Anniversary of the enthronement of our Major Archbishop-Catholicos
2027-03-05.readTitle: Readings of the day (Syro-Malankara Panchangam; the Gospel verses are unclear in the source and are read here as John 10:14–16, verify locally)
readings: God hears the boy in the wilderness
Stand firm in your faith; let all that you do be done in love
I am the good shepherd; other sheep I have
2027-03-05.verse: Do not be afraid; for God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

2027-03-06.title: Saturday of the fourth week of the Great Fast
readings: The covenant at Beer-sheba; Abraham calls on the Everlasting God
Everything created by God is good, received with thanksgiving
I must proclaim the good news to the other cities also
2027-03-06.verse: I must proclaim the good news of the kingdom of God to the other cities also; for I was sent for this purpose.

2027-03-08.title: Monday of the fifth week of the Great Fast
readings: God tests Abraham: “God himself will provide the lamb”
Be imitators of me, as I am of Christ; reverence in worship
When the bridegroom is taken away, they will fast
2027-03-08.verse: Abraham said, “God himself will provide the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So the two of them walked on together.

2027-03-09.title: Tuesday of the fifth week of the Great Fast · The Forty Martyrs of Sebaste
readings: “The Lord will provide”: the ram in place of Isaac
Completing what is lacking in Christ's afflictions for the sake of his body
Take up your cross and follow me
2027-03-09.verse: He called the crowd with his disciples, and said to them, “If any want to become my followers, let them deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.

2027-03-10.title: Wednesday of the fifth week of the Great Fast
readings: The children of Nahor; Rebekah's family
Elders who rule well are worthy of double honour
2027-03-10.verse: I have compassion for the crowd, because they have been with me now for three days and have nothing to eat;

2027-03-11.title: Thursday of the fifth week of the Great Fast
readings: Sarah dies; Abraham, a stranger, asks for a burial place
The hope laid up for you in heaven
No sign but the sign of Jonah
2027-03-11.verse: I am a stranger and an alien residing among you; give me property among you for a burying place, so that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

2027-03-12.title: Friday of the fifth week of the Great Fast
readings: Abraham pays the full price for the field of Ephron
Christ is our peace: the dividing wall broken down
Beware the yeast; do you not yet understand?
2027-03-12.verse: For he is our peace; in his flesh he has made both groups into one and has broken down the dividing wall, that is, the hostility between us.

2027-03-13.title: Saturday of the fifth week of the Great Fast
readings: The field and cave of Machpelah become Abraham's; Sarah is buried
Boasting excluded; justified by faith; we uphold the law
You are my friends; I chose you
2027-03-13.verse: No one has greater love than this, to lay down one’s life for one’s friends.

2027-03-15.title: Monday of the sixth week of the Great Fast
readings: Abraham sends his servant to find a wife for Isaac
Pray in the Spirit at all times; an ambassador in chains
“By what authority are you doing these things?”
2027-03-15.verse: Pray in the Spirit at all times in every prayer and supplication. To that end keep alert and always persevere in supplication for all the saints.

2027-03-16.title: Tuesday of the sixth week of the Great Fast
readings: The servant prays at the well
Christ in you, the hope of glory
2027-03-16.verse: To them God chose to make known how great among the Gentiles are the riches of the glory of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

2027-03-17.title: Wednesday of the sixth week of the Great Fast · St Patrick
readings: Rebekah at the well: “I will draw for your camels also”
Be imitators of God, as beloved children
“The Spirit of the Lord is upon me”
2027-03-17.verse: Therefore be imitators of God, as beloved children, and live in love, as Christ loved us and gave himself up for us, a fragrant offering and sacrifice to God.

2027-03-18.title: Thursday of the sixth week of the Great Fast · Mar Cyril of Jerusalem
readings: “I will not eat until I have told my errand”
Clothe yourselves with love; let the word of Christ dwell in you richly
You are the salt of the earth and the light of the world
2027-03-18.verse: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; teach and admonish one another in all wisdom; and with gratitude in your hearts sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.

2027-03-19.title: The Fortieth Friday · Mar Yauseph (St Joseph)
readings: Jesus fasts forty days and is tempted
David will not offer what costs him nothing
Amend your ways and your doings
Ransomed with the precious blood of Christ
Whether we live or die, we are the Lord's
Joseph did as the angel commanded
2027-03-19.verse: One does not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from the mouth of God.

2027-03-20.title: Lazarus Saturday · The Saturday of the Raising of Lazarus
readings: “Will you go with this man?” “I will.”
Christ the first fruits; the last enemy is death
2027-03-20.verse: Jesus said to her, “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?”

2027-03-22.title: Hasha Monday · Monday of Passion Week
readings: The Lord a garland of glory; “This is rest; give rest to the weary”
They will perish, but you remain
By what authority are you doing these things?
2027-03-22.verse: But you are the same, and your years will never end.

2027-03-23.title: Hasha Tuesday · Tuesday of Passion Week
readings: Moses, near death, commissions Joshua: “I will be with you”
The promise of entering his rest is still open
“And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself”
2027-03-23.verse: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.

2027-03-24.title: Hasha Wednesday · Wednesday of Passion Week
readings: A sword drawn for slaughter: “Return it to its sheath!”
Christ offered once for all to remove sin by the sacrifice of himself
Judas: “What will you give me if I betray him to you?”
2027-03-24.verse: But as it is, he has appeared once for all at the end of the age to remove sin by the sacrifice of himself.

2027-03-29.title: Monday of Hevoro week · Easter Monday
readings: You have died to the law through the body of Christ, so that you may belong to him who has been raised
The guards are paid to say the body was stolen
2027-03-29.verse: In the same way, my friends, you have died to the law through the body of Christ, so that you may belong to another, to him who has been raised from the dead in order that we may bear fruit for God.

2027-03-30.title: Tuesday of Hevoro week · Easter Tuesday
readings: Christ our paschal lamb has been sacrificed; let us celebrate the festival
A lamp is put on the lampstand; the measure you give
2027-03-30.verse: For our paschal lamb, Christ, has been sacrificed.

2027-03-31.title: Wednesday of Hevoro week · Easter Wednesday
readings: Fight the good fight, having faith and a good conscience
“For mortals it is impossible, but not for God”
2027-03-31.verse: For mortals it is impossible, but not for God; for God all things are possible.

kidsaint: The Forty Martyrs of Sebaste (9 Mar)
